slides.title: Opening
slides.body:
PurchasePlus has been working with IHG across the EAPAC region for a number of years — sitting inside your procurement workflow every day.

Today we're showing you three things that are live right now.

slides.title: Statement Search
slides.subtitle: AI-powered supplier statement reconciliation
key_points: Supplier statement arrives in any format
AI matches every line to invoices automatically
Exceptions flagged — team reviews discrepancies only

slides.title: AI Invoice Processing
slides.subtitle: From email to approved invoice — zero manual entry
key_points: Invoice arrives by email — any format (PDF, EDI)
AI reads and extracts all data automatically
3-way match: Invoice ↔ Purchase Order ↔ Receiving Note
Auto-approved or flagged — exported to accounting system

slides.title: What's Next
slides.body:
The next phase uses all of this data to deliver AI-generated procurement recommendations.

Which supplier gives you the best price. Where you're above benchmark. Where consolidation across properties saves money.

Your roadmap calls for AI in Business Intelligence. That's exactly where we're heading.

slides.title: POS & Inventory
slides.subtitle: Next-day food cost visibility — not next month
key_points: POS sales flow into inventory automatically each night
GM and F&B manager see live gross profit
